encounter_0:
So… another soul dares to breach the threshold.
You reek of forbidden power. Do you even know what it costs?
$The void remembers every footstep.
You have walked this path before. Countless times.
$Your {{cycleCount}} attempt, to be precise.
Each time the corruption erased you, and yet… remnants persist.
$The void consumes all who enter uninvited.
Memory. Identity. Purpose. All sacrificed at my threshold.
$But you… you carry something different this time.
A darkness that is not mine.

$You wield the void's own corruption as a weapon.
How delightfully forbidden.
$Do you truly believe stolen power can strike down its source?
This realm was never meant for human souls.
$Then prove it. Show me what your sacrifice has bought you.
encounter_1:
You feel it, don't you? The corruption pooling in your veins.
Every step closer to me makes it stronger.
$I have watched you stumble through this void before.
{{cycleCount}} times you have tried. {{cycleCount}} times you have fallen.
$Each cycle I consumed what was left of you.
Your memories. Your will. Your name. All dissolved into the dark.
$And yet… something survived. Some stubborn fragment refuses to break.
There is a forbidden power inside you that was not there before.
$You embraced the corruption to get here.
You sacrificed pieces of your soul for strength you were never meant to hold.

$I am the void's answer to creatures like you.
The wall between forbidden power and annihilation.
$Every soul that reached this far believed they could wield me.
None have left.
$Let us see what your sacrifice is worth.
encounter_2:
The void has a throne, and it demands a soul strong enough to claim it.
You stand at its edge. Again.
$This is your {{cycleCount}} attempt to reach what lies beyond.
The corruption remembers each one, even if you do not.
$Every cycle the darkness strips you bare.
Memory, power, purpose -- all consumed. All returned to nothing.
$Yet here you stand. Carrying forbidden power that should not exist.
The void shaped it. You chose to wield it. That changes everything.
$Something in you survived what the corruption could not erase.
A will forged in sacrifice.

$I am the final trial. The last wall between you and the void's forbidden heart.
$Strike me down, and the corruption bows to you.
Fail, and the void consumes another would-be king.
$The throne awaits. Prove yourself.
encounter_3:
Do you hear it? The void is always hungry.
It ate the world you knew. Now it reaches for you.
$This is your {{cycleCount}} offering. Each time you come, you feed it.
Your fear. Your hope. Your memories. All devoured.
$The corruption inside you is just seasoning.
Forbidden power borrowed from something that never lends willingly.
$You think you control it. You think it makes you stronger.
But every soul who embraced the void's corruption became part of it.
$I am what's left of the last one who tried.
The void consumed everything but my rage.

$Now I stand between you and the abyss.
Not to protect it. To protect you from what lies beyond.
$But you won't listen. None of them ever do.
The forbidden always calls louder than reason.
$Come, then. Feed the void one more time.
encounter_4:
Reality cracks where I stand. Can you feel it splitting?
Each step you take here unravels another thread.
$You have been unraveled before. {{cycleCount}} times.
The void stitched you back together each time, a little less whole.
$Do you remember your name from the first cycle? No?
The corruption took it. Along with every truth you once held.
$Now you carry forbidden power in the hollow where your memories should be.
A weapon made from what the void stole from you.
$How poetic. The victim wielding the wound as a blade.

$I am the fracture point. Where reality ends and the void begins.
Every soul that crossed this line dissolved into static.
$The forbidden power you embraced will not save you.
It is the void, dressed in a shape you can hold.
$But you already knew that. Step forward.
encounter_5:
Welcome back to my architecture.
Every wall, every shadow, every dead end -- I built them for you.
$This is the {{cycleCount}} time you have wandered my corridors.
The corruption preserves each attempt like a trophy.
$I designed this prison from the void's darkest corners.
Forbidden materials. Sacrificed dimensions. Consumed starlight.
$You were supposed to despair. To surrender your soul to the dark.
Instead you broke my walls and stole forbidden power from the rubble.
$Resourceful. Reckless. Human.

$The corruption you carry was never yours to take.
It is the mortar of this place. Pull too much, and the prison collapses.
$On both of us.
But you don't care about that, do you?
$Then let us see whose structure holds. Mine, or yours.
encounter_6:
I am the consequence.
Every soul that reached for forbidden power meets me at the end.
$You have reached for it {{cycleCount}} times.
Each time the void sent me to collect what was owed.
$Memory. Willpower. Identity. The corruption takes its payment
whether you offer it willingly or not.
$You call it forbidden power. I call it the void's leash.
The more you wield, the tighter it pulls.
$Yet something in you refuses to choke.
Something burns where the corruption should have left ash.

$I have executed countless souls who thought they were special.
Who believed the void's corruption chose them.
$It did not choose you. You stole it.
And now you must face what the void sends for thieves.
$Draw your stolen power. Let us settle the debt.
encounter_7:
Can you smell it? That sweet decay.
It is the void rotting through the walls of reality.
$You have carried my infection {{cycleCount}} times now.
Each cycle you brought it deeper into the living world.
$The corruption in your veins? That is my pollen.
Forbidden power wrapped in spores that bloom in dying souls.
$Every creature you have touched since entering the void is contaminated.
Every bond you forged is a vector.
$You are not a warrior. You are a carrier.

$The forbidden power you wield is my favorite symptom.
It makes the host feel invincible right before total organ failure.
$I am the void's immune response. The fever that burns out intruders.
Except you keep surviving the fever.
$So the void sent something stronger. Something terminal.
$I am the cure for the disease of hope.
encounter_8:
Move your hand.
Did you choose to? Or did I make you think you chose to?
$I have been pulling your strings for {{cycleCount}} cycles.
Every decision you made? I made it first.
$That team you chose. Those moves you learned.
The forbidden power you embraced. All according to my choreography.
$The corruption is not a weapon. It is a leash.
And I have been walking you through the void on it.
$Every victory felt earned. Every sacrifice felt meaningful.
Because I designed them to feel that way.

$You are the void's favorite puppet.
So responsive. So convinced of free will.
$The forbidden power surging through you right now?
I am the one feeding it to you. Through the strings.
$But puppets that grow too strong sometimes snap their threads.
Let us see if you are strong enough to dance on your own.
encounter_9:
You were never meant to leave.
Not this time. Not the {{cycleCount}} time. Not ever.
$This is not a trial. There is no reward at the end.
The void does not test souls. It collects them.
$Every cycle you believed you were making progress.
Crawling toward a light that does not exist.
$The forbidden power you carry is the bait.
Corruption shaped into something that feels like hope.
$I planted it in you to keep you moving.
A rat in a maze needs motivation to run.

$I am the warden. Not the final boss.
There is no final boss. Only walls within walls.
$The corruption you wield tears down one wall
and reveals another behind it. Deeper. Darker.
$You will fight me. You will believe you won.
And then the next cycle will begin.
$Run, little rat. The maze is infinite.
firstStageWin_0:
The corruption you wield… it is real.
You have embraced what should have destroyed you.
$Then let the void answer in full. No mercy. No restraint.
firstStageWin_1:
Interesting… You did not shatter.
The corruption inside you burns brighter than I expected.
$Then I will stop playing. Let the void's true darkness answer yours.
firstStageWin_2:
You broke through… The forbidden power in you is no accident.
The void did not give it lightly.
$Now face what lies beneath. The true test begins.
firstStageWin_3:
Still standing… The void has never tasted anything like you.
That forbidden power… it makes the darkness recoil.
$Then let us see if it recoils from this.
firstStageWin_4:
Reality shudders… You actually broke through.
The forbidden power you carry is rewriting the rules.
$Then let me show you what exists where rules do not.
firstStageWin_5:
My walls… crumbling. The forbidden power you stole is stronger than I built for.
The void's own corruption turns against its architect.
$Then I will become the prison myself. Break me if you can.
firstStageWin_6:
The debt… is deeper than I measured.
Your forbidden power is not stolen. It was forged.
$Then the void demands a higher price. I will extract it myself.
firstStageWin_7:
The infection… recedes? Your forbidden power is burning
the corruption clean. Purging what should be permanent.
$Then I will become the plague itself. No cure. No remission.
firstStageWin_8:
You snapped a string… Impossible.
The forbidden power in you is rewriting my commands.
$Then I will pull harder. Every string at once.
firstStageWin_9:
You tore through my wall… but do you see it?
Another wall behind it. Exactly as I promised.
$The forbidden power you carry just built my next cage.
Feel it closing already.
secondStageWin_3: …The hunger… stops. What did you do to me?
secondStageWin_6: …The debt is paid. The void… releases its claim.
secondStageWin_8: …The puppet's soul… has triumphed… for now.
secondStageWin_9: …You have shattered this cage… but deeper prisons await… and the darkness never forgets its prey.
